hook: An austere elder nobleman confronts Rupert in a grand hallway, sharply telling him 'You have a rat in your cellar,' immediately establishing tension and a hidden threat.
cliffhanger: The elder nobleman announces they will stop hiding the prisoner and give people a reason to condemn her.
standalone_clarity: A new viewer can easily understand that a powerful conspiracy is panicking over a hidden prisoner in their cellar, though specific backstories on Juliana are absent.
narrative_context: The elder nobleman confronts Rupert about rumors spreading regarding the imprisoned Juliana and insists on a more ruthless solution.
promotional_strength: The sharp conflict and intimidation establish immediate high-stakes villainy and intrigue.

evidence.observation: Establishes the arrival of the stern elder nobleman.
The nobleman warns Rupert about whispers regarding the prisoner.
The nobleman pins Rupert against the wall with his cane.

logline: When rumors of the poisoned Duchess begin spreading among the servants, Rupert and Catherine conspire with an elder nobleman to fabricate a witchcraft charge against Juliana, sealing her fate for the gallows.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Low-angle tracking shot following polished black dress shoes and the tip of a gold-handled cane striding deliberately along a sunlit marble hallway, tilting up gradually to reveal an austere, grey-haired elder nobleman.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: Rhythmic, heavy footsteps and the sharp metallic click of a cane striking the polished stone floor.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: The Elder Nobleman walks with stern, unhurried authority, dressed in an immaculate black tailcoat and dark vest with a gold pocket watch chain.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of Rupert standing nervously beside ornate double doors, wearing black gloves and an embroidered dark coat, glancing up with anxiety.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: A firm tap of the wooden walking stick halting against the floor.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Two-shot profile of the Elder Nobleman facing Rupert in the vaulted corridor.

source_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Cold, Accusatory)
source_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: You have a rat in your cellar, Rupert. And the servants are beginning to smell it.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Rupert defensive and agitated.

source_segments.label: RUPERT (Defensive, Anxious)
source_segments.speaker: RUPERT
source_segments.text: The Ashcroft girl is locked tight. Nobody knows she is down there.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of the Elder Nobleman fixing Rupert with a piercing, contemptuous glare.

source_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Stern, Disapproving)
source_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: The kitchen maids are whispering. They see the soup bowls returned unwiped. They see your guards outside the lower grates.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Rupert looking down, nervously pulling at his black leather gloves as dread creeps over his face.

source_segments.label: RUPERT (Muttered, Paranoid)
source_segments.speaker: RUPERT
source_segments.text: She knows the Duchess was poisoned.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Tight close-up on the Elder Nobleman's unyielding eyes narrowing in cold calculation.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Tight close-up of Rupert swallows hard, breathless with dread.

source_segments.label: RUPERT (Fearful)
source_segments.speaker: RUPERT
source_segments.text: If she speaks...

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium two-shot as the Elder Nobleman lunges forward aggressively, stepping into Rupert's personal space.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: The Elder Nobleman thrusts the gold knob of his walking stick directly against Rupert's chest, pinning him against the wall.

source_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Fierce, Venomous)
source_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: Then make certain she isn't! A peasant weed, Rupert! You do not store weeds in your cellar, you burn them!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Low-angle close-up of Rupert gasping softly, intimidated by the cane pressed firmly beneath his cravat.

source_segments.label: RUPERT (Faltering, Submissive)
source_segments.speaker: RUPERT
source_segments.text: What are you suggesting?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot as the Elder Nobleman withdraws his cane and turns sharply toward the library doors.

source_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Calculated, Ominous)
source_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: We stop hiding the prisoner.

hook: The heavy mahogany doors swing open and the conspirators gather around a fireplace to plan how to legally destroy their captive.
cliffhanger: When Catherine asks what to do if the prisoner claims to be a healer, the nobleman chillingly replies, 'Then call it witchcraft.'
standalone_clarity: Clearly showcases villains plotting a judicial frame-up, making the stakes obvious to any viewer.
narrative_context: The conspirators formulate their evil plan to escalate a prisoner's case into a capital witchcraft charge.
promotional_strength: Delivers a chilling villainous plotting sequence that highlights the ruthlessness of the antagonists.

evidence.observation: The nobleman outlines the strategy to use the law to destroy the prisoner.
The nobleman chillingly suggests calling the healer's defense witchcraft.

logline: When rumors of the poisoned Duchess begin spreading among the servants, Rupert and Catherine conspire with an elder nobleman to fabricate a witchcraft charge against Juliana, sealing her fate for the gallows.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Tracking shot from behind the Elder Nobleman as he pushes open the heavy double doors into the dark wood-paneled library.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: The heavy creak of massive mahogany doors gliding open on brass hinges.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Front medium shot of the Elder Nobleman pausing inside the library doorway, Rupert following behind him.

source_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Deadpan, Sinister)
source_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: We give them a reason to condemn her.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide shot of Catherine standing regally before the roaring stone hearth, dressed in an ornate burgundy and gold brocade gown, slowly unfurling a red lace fan.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Inquiring, Sharp)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: You have a solution?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Side profile close-up of the Elder Nobleman speaking with icy confidence.

source_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Ruthless)
source_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: We use the law to destroy her.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Rupert looking bewildered.

source_segments.label: RUPERT (Confused)
source_segments.speaker: RUPERT
source_segments.text: The law?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Tracking medium shot as the Elder Nobleman paces slowly behind the massive mahogany desk lined with books and a glass of whiskey.

source_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Pragmatic, Scheming)
source_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: A maid with herbs in her possession, a secret medicine, an unauthorized visit to the Duchess's chamber.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: The Elder Nobleman leans both hands against the desk, leaning forward intently.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of Catherine fluttering her fan beneath her chin, smirking approvingly.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot framing the Elder Nobleman seated at the desk beside Catherine standing in the firelight.

source_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Cold, Calculating)
source_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: Give those facts to a magistrate in the right order, and she becomes a poisoner.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of Catherine gently moving her fan, raising an intrigued brow.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Curious, Conniving)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: And if she claims she is a healer?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Tight close-up of the Elder Nobleman's face illuminated by warm firelight.

source_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Sinister)
source_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: Then call it witchcraft.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Rupert wide-eyed with shock at the severity of the plan.

source_segments.label: RUPERT (Stunned)
source_segments.speaker: RUPERT
source_segments.text: Witchcraft is a capital charge.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Straight-on close-up of the Elder Nobleman staring back without a flicker of remorse.

source_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Unflinching)
source_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: Precisely.
